hookups.source: https://maps.campendium.com/ca/ab/camping-rv/coutts-rv-park (aggregator; read 2026-11-10; the operator has no page of its own): review Oct 24, 2019 'This campground has a dozen pull through sites with water, sewer and 30 amp electric hookups'; Oct 2023 review '30 Amp, water, sewer'

sites.source: https://maps.campendium.com/ca/ab/camping-rv/coutts-rv-park (aggregator; read 2026-11-10; no operator page): 'a dozen pull through sites', 'Easy for big rigs to get in'

note: Small self-serve gravel RV lot in the Village of Coutts, a block from the Coutts/Sweetgrass border crossing; the village's business directory lists it as Kev's Korner RV Park, with the office at Kerv's Korner food store (101 Centre Ave). A tree row on each side; sites close together. No operator website. --Claude
summary: No operator page: the stored village page answers 400 and the village's current camping page does not mention the park. Identified as Kev's Korner RV Park (village business directory, phone 403-344-3802). Hookups/sites re-sourced as reported (Campendium, the only source). Note rewritten. Presence fails - drop candidate; ownership looks private.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (presence): no operator website, and Google Maps has no listing for the RV park - the phone 403-344-3802 resolves to "Kerv's Korner Food Store" (101 Centre Ave, Coutts) with 4.0 stars from 2 reviews. The presence rule needs a working website with a phone, or Google open with 25+ reviews and a phone: fails. Price indicator only via RV Life (stored tier 1, $) - Campendium camper reports $15 (2019) and $20 (Oct 12, 2023, 'stayed 1 night, great price $20 for water and power') - none 2024+, so no fees written.

OWNERSHIP: stored local; nothing shows the village runs it. The Village of Coutts lists 'Kev's Korner RV Park - RV Park Office 403-344-3802 - 101 Centre Ave' in its BUSINESS directory (https://www.couttsalberta.com/business-directory-1/kev's-korner-rv-park, 200), and its own Recreation and Camping page names only Writing-on-Stone and Gold Springs. Recommend private (and the private gates then apply).
NAME: published name in the village directory is 'Kev's Korner RV Park'; Campendium calls it 'Coutts RV Park' (2nd Ave N, same phone 403-344-3802).

WEBSITE: stored http://www.couttsalberta.com/coutts_camping.html now answers 400 (the village site moved to Wix); the Wayback copies of that page (2023-2024) never mentioned this park - they list only Writing-on-Stone and Gold Springs. No replacement operator page exists; the only official mention is the business-directory page above (200).
PHONE (stored empty): 403-344-3802 ('RV Park Office' in the village business directory; same number on Campendium and on Google's Kerv's Korner Food Store).
GOOGLE: no RV-park listing; searches for 'Coutts RV Park' land on Gold Springs Park Campground (a different campground 10 km north, 4.5 / 233). Kerv's Korner Food Store 4.0 / 2 reviews.

LONG-STAY: reads as a transient overnight lot (Campendium: 'a good place to stay if you are just looking to rest before continuing your travel'; one reviewer was the only camper) - no long-stay signs.

PIN: stored 49.00413,-111.96342 sits in a ~90 x 25 m gravel/weed strip between a deciduous tree row (north) and a conifer row (south), with a small steel building at its east end - matches the reviews' description; Campendium's point 49.004341,-111.964018 is ~50 m west in the same strip. OK. No units visible in the imagery.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (village lot; nearest water is a salt pond/lagoon ~700 m east beyond the highway and rail line).

EXTRA (2026-11-10): the Town of Milk River camping page https://www.milkriver.ca/p/camping-facilities (200) lists under REGIONAL CAMPGROUNDS 'Coutts R.V. Park (403) 344-3802' - the same phone, so the park is current enough for a neighbouring town to list it; still no operator page, and Google has no RV-park listing, so presence still fails.
